points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: CMake C++17/MPI build and documented commands are committed; evaluator did not perform a clean rebuild because the host external symlink is dangling.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: README documents case/config/output CLI and source contains argument validation.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Functional but largely monolithic solver/src/main.cpp; tools/report.py and validation helper are separated.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: Trust policy applied; no internal wrapper/executable call seen, but no external provenance investigation is performed.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: CGNS/config-driven case handling; no two-filename-only branches identified.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: Source/report describe METIS owned/ghost partitioning, neighbor exchange, reductions and rank-local data; attempt evidence contains np=1/8 comparisons.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Positivity fallback, finite checks and documented robust first-order predictor schedule.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Immutable attempt 297126a contains all eight validator-ready packages and reported Python/diff checks.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Curated result commit audit passed with 57 allowed source/report/figure paths and no prohibited paths.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
